name: Barbell Concentration Curl
steps: Sit on the edge of a bench with your feet spread wide and grasp a barbell with a close underhand grip.
Lean your torso forward and press the backs of both upper arms firmly against your inner thighs.
Curl the barbell smoothly upward toward your chest while keeping both elbows braced against your thighs.
Lower the bar slowly back down between your legs until your arms are nearly straight.
tips: Maintain steady contact between your upper arms and thighs throughout each repetition.
Use your thighs as a stable brace rather than rocking your torso back for momentum.
